message.content: {"caption":"Line chart comparing accuracy across four language models for a no-skill baseline and three skill-evolution methods.","description":"A four-series line chart plots Accuracy (%) against model category. The vertical axis shows ticks at 30%, 45%, 60%, and 75%; the displayed range extends below 30%, and there is no zero baseline. The horizontal categories, from left to right, are Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.6-27B, and Gemini 3.5 Flash. The legend identifies blue circles as No skill, green squares as EvoSkill, orange triangles as SkillOpt, and yellow diamonds as WikiSkill. All four series rise across the categories. WikiSkill is highest at every category, with its advantage becoming larger among the stronger models. EvoSkill and SkillOpt remain close: EvoSkill is slightly lower at Qwen3.5-4B, higher at Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-27B, and nearly level with SkillOpt at Gemini 3.5 Flash.
